t: Used for bottling honey and other fluids. Honey can be pumped into the side or it can be placed next to a centrifuge to be filled automatically.$(br2)The bottler together with a piston can be used to bottle up bees as well, see $(l:genetics/transferring)genetics page$(/l).
用于装瓶蜂蜜和其他流体。蜂蜜可以从侧面泵入，也可以将它放在离心机旁边自动灌装。$(br2)装瓶机配合活塞也可以把蜜蜂装进瓶子里，详见$(l:genetics/transferring)基因工程页面$(/l)。
